doc_title_en: Notice on Changes to Dividend Policy (Increase in Payout Ratio, Introduction of DOE) and Revision to Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
doc_title_jp: 配当方針の変更（配当性向の引き上げ、DOE導入）及び配当予想の修正（増配）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 株主への利益還元の充実と配当の安定性向上を両立させ、中長期的な株主価値の向上を目指す

summary_en: Payout ratio raised from 40% to 50%; DOE (dividend-on-equity) floor of 5% introduced. Policy applies from Q2 FY3/27. FY3/27 annual dividend guidance revised upward to ¥100/share (¥50 interim + ¥50 final) from prior ¥80/share guidance. Minimum annual dividend floor set at forward guidance level.
summary_jp: 配当性向を40%から50%に引き上げ。DOE（連結純資産配当率）5%の下限導入。FY3/27第2四半期から適用。通期配当を¥80/株から¥100/株に修正（中間¥50、期末¥50）。年間下限を当初予想値に設定。
tag_en: Dividend policy - payout ratio 50% (from 40%), DOE 5% floor introduced - FY3/27 annual dividend raised to ¥100/share (from ¥80 guidance)
tag_jp: 配当方針変更 - 配当性向50%（従来40%）、DOE 5%水準導入 - 通期配当予想を¥100/株に修正（従来¥80）
